message.reasoning_content:
Both look clean, readable, good hierarchy. p-prep: left vertical label "PREPARATION · 准备清单" characters overlap slightly ("准备清单" stacked) — minor, decorative. Also left column has large empty area at bottom but acceptable. p-status good.

Record visual for these two pages with improvement noting p-prep vertical label crowding (decorative). Actually to avoid over-flagging, I could mention it as improvement. It's minor; fine to note.

Then content assessment globally: need evidence covering all pages — I have evidence id 4fc9e8b... (pages 1-4) and c00ba1e... (5-6). For global summary content check I can use both evidence ids in one record with page_ids all 6, global_summary=true.

Content review: titles contain 行程原则, 第一天, 第二天, 准备清单 verbatim? 
- p-principles title: "行程原则：慢行、拍照、留机动" ✓
- p-day1: "第一天：芦汀园与旧街摄影（步行上限4.6公里）" ✓
- p-day2: "第二天：星港步道与书店休息（步行上限3.2公里）" ✓
- p-prep: "准备清单：步行、摄影与信息核对" ✓
Data: 2天, 5人, 4.6, 3.2 ✓. No fabricated dates (出行日期 待定 — fine, says 待定 and 资料未记录). No budget fabricated. 票价/班次/营业时间 marked 未确定 ✓. 已完成 0项 marked.

One possible content issue: p-day1 "上午/下午" split — source doesn't specify morning/afternoon order. It's an added ordering detail. Hmm, source says "首日步行上限4.6公里，安排芦汀园与旧街摄影" without time order. Adding 上午/下午 is a mild invention of sequence. Similarly "首日... 次日..." is given. Is 上午芦汀园、下午旧街 fabricated? Yes, mildly — it's a scheduling detail not in source. Should flag as improvement? Could be blocker per "不编造". I'd flag as improvement (not a data fabrication like date/budget, but an unsupported ordering claim). Options: fix by revising — but p-day1 has used 2 reworks already (max two 返工). So cannot revise. So record as improvement with page_ids p-day1 and keep in remaining_issues.

Also p-day1 "不设置集合时限以外的硬指标" — mentions 集合时限, which implies a fixed gathering time not in source. Mild. Combine into same issue.

Also p-day1 footer mentions "两段安排" — fine.

Content issue: p-principles "拍摄停留计入行程节奏" — reasonable interpretation of 保留机动时间/偏好拍照. OK.

So content: one improvement on p-day1 (unsupported 上午/下午 sequence and 集合时限 wording). Content otherwise passes globally.

Record visual (pages 5-6) now.
